description.value: Diplomat Bakery is a family-owned European-style dessert bakery operating since 1996, specializing in luxury cakes, cheesecakes, and espresso-based drinks. Located on London Road in Richmond near the Dyke Road entrance, it sits close to popular cycling routes along the Richmond dyke trail system. Cyclists can stop in for a range of coffee drinks, cakes by the slice, or pre-order whole cakes for pickup.
